body:
These Ontario Purple Fluorite in Calcite Touchstones were one of our most thrilling discoveries at the Denver Gem Show—and we got access before the doors even opened. Sourced from the Schickler Occurrence in Harcourt, Ontario, this small-batch find combines two high-frequency minerals in one breathtaking formation: deep-violet Fluorite growing within glossy, light-reflective Calcite.

What makes this piece so unique isn’t just the rarity—it’s the energetic synergy.

  • Purple Fluorite is known for its power to clear mental fog, psychic debris, and energetic interference. It’s deeply tied to the third eye and crown chakras, offering protection and spiritual focus during meditation, intuitive work, or energetic overload.

  • Calcite acts like a crystalline amplifier—gently clearing stagnant energy while elevating the vibration of whatever it touches. It creates a supportive container for integration, peace, and energetic coherence.

Together, they create a high-frequency “clean slate”—ideal for those who are highly sensitive, energetically overloaded, or craving stillness and clarity in a chaotic world.

Use this stone when you’re ready to:

  • Cut through noise and mental clutter

  • Feel grounded while staying spiritually open

  • Protect your intuitive field while expanding it

  • Work with pure energy without emotional residue
